nodes.label: 我现在吃得越来越多。 (Wǒ xiànzài chī de yuè lái yuè duō.) - I now eat more and more.
马可，你的中文越说越好了！ (Mǎkě, nǐ de Zhōngwén yuè shuō yuè hǎo le!) - Marco, your Chinese is getting better and better!
哪里哪里，我们班王静说得更好。 (Nǎli nǎli, wǒmen bān Wáng Jìng shuō de gèng hǎo.) - Not at all, Wang Jing in our class speaks even better.
怎么好？ (Zěnme hǎo?) - How good is she?
她的汉语说得跟中国人一样好。 (Tā de Hànyǔ shuō de gēn Zhōngguórén yíyàng hǎo.) - She speaks Chinese as well as a Chinese person.
王静？我怎么没听说过这个名字？ (Wáng Jìng? Wǒ zěnme méi tīngshuōguo zhège míngzi?) - Wang Jing? Why haven't I ever heard this name?
她是我们的汉语老师。 (Tā shì wǒmen de Hànyǔ lǎoshī.) - She is our Chinese teacher.
别吃了，你已经吃了三块蛋糕了。 (Bié chī le, nǐ yǐjīng chīle sān kuài dàngāo le.) - Stop eating, you have already eaten three pieces of cake.
这是最后一块。 (Zhè shì zuìhòu yíkuàir.) - This is the last piece.
你总是吃甜的东西，会越吃越胖。 (Nǐ zǒngshì chī tián de dōngxi, huì yuè chī yuè pàng.) - You always eat sweet things; you will get fatter and fatter.
你放心，我一定不会变胖。 (Nǐ fàng xīn, wǒ yídìng bú huì biàn pàng.) - Don't worry, I definitely won't get fat.
为什么？ (Wèi shénme?) - Why?
我们家的人都很瘦，吃不胖。 (Wǒmen jiā de rén dōu hěn shòu, chī bú pàng.) - The people in my family are all very thin and can't get fat from eating.
我有点儿害怕。 (Wǒ yǒudiǎnr hàipà.) - I am a little scared.
怎么了？ (Zěnme le?) - What's wrong?
山越高，路越难走。 (Shān yuè gāo, lù yuè nán zǒu.) - The higher the mountain, the harder the path is to walk.
我也越爬越冷。 (Wǒ yě yuè pá yuè lěng.) - I also get colder and colder the more I climb.
不用担心，有我呢，我对这儿比较了解。 (Bú yòng dān xīn, yǒu wǒ ne, wǒ duì zhèr bǐjiào liǎojiě.) - No need to worry, I'm here; I know this place fairly well.
那我们先休息一下，一会儿再爬。 (Nà wǒmen xiān xiūxi yíxià, yíhuìr zài pá.) - Then let's rest first and climb again in a while.
好，一会儿我们可以从中间这条路上去。 (Hǎo, yíhuìr wǒmen kěyǐ cóng zhōngjiān zhè tiáo lù shàngqu.) - OK, in a while we can go up by the path in the middle.
小明，你的眼睛怎么跟大熊猫一样了？ (Xiǎomíng, nǐ de yǎnjing zěnme gēn dà xióngmāo yíyàng le?) - Xiaoming, why do your eyes look like a giant panda's?
我这几天脚疼，没休息好。 (Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān jiǎo téng, méi xiūxi hǎo.) - My foot has hurt these past few days and I haven't rested well.
去医院了吗？ (Qù yīyuàn le ma?) - Did you go to the hospital?
医生说什么？ (Yīshēng shuō shénme?) - What did the doctor say?
他让我多休息。 (Tā ràng wǒ duō xiūxi.) - He told me to rest more.
休息得越多，好得越快。 (Xiūxi de yuè duō, hǎo de yuè kuài.) - The more I rest, the faster I get better.
下个月的篮球比赛，你能参加吗？ (Xià ge yuè de lánqiú bǐsài, nǐ néng cānjiā ma?) - Can you take part in next month's basketball match?
一定能参加，一点儿影响也没有。 (Yídìng néng cānjiā, yìdiǎnr yǐngxiǎng yě méiyǒu.) - Definitely, there is no effect at all.
雨越下越大。 (Yǔ yuè xià yuè dà.) - The rain is getting heavier and heavier.
你的中文越说越好。 (Nǐ de Zhōngwén yuè shuō yuè hǎo.) - Your Chinese is getting better the more you speak it.
越往南，天气越热。 (Yuè wǎng nán, tiānqì yuè rè.) - The further south you go, the hotter the weather is.
山越高，路越难走。 (Shān yuè gāo, lù yuè nán zǒu.) - The higher the mountain, the harder the path is to walk.
这本书跟那本书一样。 (Zhè běn shū gēn nà běn shū yíyàng.) - This book is the same as that book.
儿子跟爸爸一样高。 (Érzi gēn bàba yíyàng gāo.) - The son is as tall as his father.
这辆车的颜色跟那辆车不一样。 (Zhè liàng chē de yánsè gēn nà liàng chē bù yíyàng.) - The color of this car is not the same as that car.
她的汉语说得跟中国人一样好。 (Tā de Hànyǔ shuō de gēn Zhōngguórén yíyàng hǎo.) - She speaks Chinese as well as a Chinese person.
这两件衣服一样。 (Zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu yíyàng.) - These two pieces of clothing are the same.
她的汉语说得跟中国人一样好。 (Tā de Hànyǔ shuō de gēn Zhōngguórén yíyàng hǎo.) - She speaks Chinese as well as a Chinese person.
这次我不一定能考好。 (Zhè cì wǒ bù yídìng néng kǎo hǎo.) - This time I may not do well in the exam.
我一定不会变胖。 (Wǒ yídìng bú huì biàn pàng.) - I definitely won't get fat.
我很了解他。 (Wǒ hěn liǎojiě tā.) - I know him very well.
我对这儿比较了解。 (Wǒ duì zhèr bǐjiào liǎojiě.) - I know this place fairly well.
你能参加吗？ (Nǐ néng cānjiā ma?) - Can you take part?
他影响了我。 (Tā yǐngxiǎng le wǒ.) - He influenced me.
一点儿影响也没有。 (Yìdiǎnr yǐngxiǎng yě méiyǒu.) - There is no effect at all.
你怎么又迟到了？ (Nǐ zěnme yòu chídào le?) - Why are you late again?
你吃这么多，会越来越胖。 (Nǐ chī zhème duō, huì yuè lái yuè pàng.) - You eat so much, you will get fatter and fatter.
你怎么知道她会来？ (Nǐ zěnme zhīdào tā huì lái?) - How do you know she will come?
你想要哪本书？ (Nǐ xiǎng yào nǎ běn shū?) - Which book do you want?
下午你打算做什么？ (Xiàwǔ nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?) - What do you plan to do this afternoon?
你给我的那本书我看完了。 (Nǐ gěi wǒ de nà běn shū wǒ kàn wán le.) - I have finished reading the book you gave me.
你觉得怎么样？ (Nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?) - What do you think of it?
你的汉字一直很好，这次考试一定没问题。 (Nǐ de Hànzì yìzhí hěn hǎo, zhè cì kǎoshì yídìng méi wèntí.) - Your characters have always been good; you will definitely have no problem in this exam.
那我也开始跑步吧。 (Nà wǒ yě kāishǐ pǎobù ba.) - Then I'll start running too.
好，一定能变瘦。 (Hǎo, yídìng néng biàn shòu.) - OK, you will definitely be able to get thinner.
王静的汉语说得怎么样？为什么？ (Wáng Jìng de Hànyǔ shuō de zěnmeyàng? Wèi shénme?) - How well does Wang Jing speak Chinese? Why?
小刚一共吃了几块蛋糕？ (Xiǎogāng yígòng chīle jǐ kuài dàngāo?) - How many pieces of cake did Xiaogang eat in total?
小丽觉得小刚会越来越胖吗？为什么？ (Xiǎolì juéde Xiǎogāng huì yuè lái yuè pàng ma? Wèi shénme?) - Does Xiaoli think Xiaogang will get fatter and fatter? Why?
小丽为什么害怕了？小刚害怕吗？ (Xiǎolì wèi shénme hàipà le? Xiǎogāng hàipà ma?) - Why did Xiaoli become scared? Is Xiaogang scared?
小明怎么了？ (Xiǎomíng zěnme le?) - What is wrong with Xiaoming?
小明能参加篮球比赛吗？为什么？ (Xiǎomíng néng cānjiā lánqiú bǐsài ma? Wèi shénme?) - Can Xiaoming take part in the basketball match? Why?
很晚睡觉。 (Hěn wǎn shuìjiào.) - Go to bed very late.
很晚回家。 (Hěn wǎn huí jiā.) - Come home very late.
每天锻炼身体。 (Měitiān duànliàn shēntǐ.) - Exercise every day.
总是帮助同学。 (Zǒngshì bāngzhù tóngxué.) - Always help classmates.
吃很多水果。 (Chī hěn duō shuǐguǒ.) - Eat a lot of fruit.
用中文跟朋友聊天儿。 (Yòng Zhōngwén gēn péngyou liáotiānr.) - Chat with friends in Chinese.
越晚睡觉，身体越不好。 (Yuè wǎn shuìjiào, shēntǐ yuè bù hǎo.) - The later you go to bed, the worse your health.
几点起床？ (Jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?) - What time do you get up?
早上吃什么？ (Zǎoshang chī shénme?) - What do you eat in the morning?
中午去哪儿吃饭？ (Zhōngwǔ qù nǎr chīfàn?) - Where do you go to eat at noon?
怎么锻炼身体？ (Zěnme duànliàn shēntǐ?) - How do you exercise?
对什么感兴趣？ (Duì shénme gǎn xìngqù?) - What are you interested in?
每天复习多长时间？ (Měitiān fùxí duō cháng shíjiān?) - How long do you review every day?
他7:00起床。 (Tā qī diǎn qǐchuáng.) - He gets up at 7:00.
我跟他不一样。 (Wǒ gēn tā bù yíyàng.) - I am not the same as him.
我8:00起床。 (Wǒ bā diǎn qǐchuáng.) - I get up at 8:00.
三人行，必有我师。 (Sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī.) - When three people walk together, there must be one I can learn from.

这句话用来比喻别人身上可能有我们没有的优点，我们要学习别人身上的优点。 (Zhè jù huà yòng lái bǐyù biérén shēn shang kěnéng yǒu wǒmen méiyǒu de yōudiǎn, wǒmen yào xuéxí biérén shēn shang de yōudiǎn.) - This saying is used to mean that others may have merits we lack, and we should learn from the merits of others.
大山，你和马可谁个子高？ (Dàshān, nǐ hé Mǎkě shéi gèzi gāo?) - Dashan, who is taller, you or Marco?
马可比我高，我比马可矮一点儿。 (Mǎkě bǐ wǒ gāo, wǒ bǐ Mǎkě ǎi yìdiǎnr.) - Marco is taller than me; I am a little shorter than Marco.
那你们谁大？ (Nà nǐmen shéi dà?) - Then which of you is older?
我比马可大两岁。 (Wǒ bǐ Mǎkě dà liǎng suì.) - I am two years older than Marco.
你们谁的汉语说得更好？ (Nǐmen shéi de Hànyǔ shuō de gèng hǎo?) - Which of you speaks Chinese better?
马可比我说得好一些，我的汉语没有他好。 (Mǎkě bǐ wǒ shuō de hǎo yìxiē, wǒ de Hànyǔ méiyǒu tā hǎo.) - Marco speaks a bit better than me; my Chinese is not as good as his.
我喜欢历史课、体育课，不喜欢数学课。 (Wǒ xǐhuan lìshǐ kè, tǐyù kè, bù xǐhuan shùxué kè.) - I like history class and P.E. class, but I don't like maths class.
为什么？ (Wèi shénme?) - Why?
数学也很有意思啊。 (Shùxué yě hěn yǒuyìsi a.) - Maths is also very interesting.
我觉得数学比历史难多了，我听不懂。 (Wǒ juéde shùxué bǐ lìshǐ nán duō le, wǒ tīng bu dǒng.) - I think maths is much harder than history; I can't understand it.
别担心，我可以帮你。 (Bié dān xīn, wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ.) - Don't worry, I can help you.
好啊，我们每天学多长时间？ (Hǎo a, wǒmen měi tiān xué duō cháng shíjiān?) - OK, how long shall we study every day?
一两个小时吧。 (Yì-liǎng ge xiǎoshí ba.) - One or two hours.
你最近比以前来得早多了，搬家了？ (Nǐ zuìjìn bǐ yǐqián lái de zǎo duō le, bān jiā le?) - You have been coming much earlier than before recently; did you move house?
是啊，你不知道？ (Shì a, nǐ bù zhīdào?) - Yes, didn't you know?
我上个月就搬家了，走路二十分钟就到。 (Wǒ shàng ge yuè jiù bān jiā le, zǒu lù èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.) - I moved last month; it takes only twenty minutes to walk here.
那很方便啊。 (Nà hěn fāngbiàn a.) - That's very convenient.
我还打算买辆自行车，骑车七八分钟就能到。 (Wǒ hái dǎsuàn mǎi liàng zìxíngchē, qí chē qī-bā fēnzhōng jiù néng dào.) - I also plan to buy a bicycle; by bike it takes only seven or eight minutes.
你不是有一辆吗？ (Nǐ bú shì yǒu yí liàng ma?) - Don't you already have one?
那辆太旧了，要换一辆，很便宜，两三百块钱。 (Nà liàng tài jiù le, yào huàn yí liàng, hěn piányi, liǎng-sān bǎi kuài qián.) - That one is too old and needs to be replaced; they are cheap, two or three hundred yuan.
这两个地方的房子一样吗？ (Zhè liǎng ge dìfang de fángzi yíyàng ma?) - Are the houses in these two places the same?
不一样。 (Bù yíyàng.) - No, they are not the same.
您看，学校外边的房子比学校里边的大一些。 (Nín kàn, xuéxiào wàibian de fángzi bǐ xuéxiào lǐbian de dà yìxiē.) - Look, the houses outside the school are a bit bigger than those inside the school.
大小没关系，主要是环境，哪个更安静？ (Dàxiǎo méi guānxi, zhǔyào shì huánjìng, nǎge gèng ānjìng?) - Size doesn't matter; the main thing is the environment. Which is quieter?
学校里边的没有学校外边的那么安静。 (Xuéxiào lǐbian de méiyǒu xuéxiào wàibian de nàme ānjìng.) - The ones inside the school are not as quiet as those outside the school.
哪个方便一些呢？ (Nǎge fāngbiàn yìxiē ne?) - Which is a bit more convenient?
学校里边比学校外边方便，附近有三四个车站。 (Xuéxiào lǐbian bǐ xuéxiào wàibian fāngbiàn, fùjìn yǒu sān-sì ge chēzhàn.) - Inside the school is more convenient than outside; there are three or four bus stops nearby.
大山比大卫矮一点儿。 (Dàshān bǐ Dàwèi ǎi yìdiǎnr.) - Dashan is a little shorter than David.
我今天起得比昨天晚一些。 (Wǒ jīntiān qǐ de bǐ zuótiān wǎn yìxiē.) - I got up a bit later today than yesterday.
今天的作业比昨天多得多。 (Jīntiān de zuòyè bǐ zuótiān duō de duō.) - Today's homework is much more than yesterday's.
数学比历史难多了。 (Shùxué bǐ lìshǐ nán duō le.) - Maths is much harder than history.
咖啡没有茶好喝。 (Kāfēi méiyǒu chá hǎohē.) - Coffee is not as nice to drink as tea.
他没有我这么高。 (Tā méiyǒu wǒ zhème gāo.) - He is not as tall as me.
这个电影没有那个电影那么有意思。 (Zhège diànyǐng méiyǒu nàge diànyǐng nàme yǒuyìsi.) - This film is not as interesting as that film.
学校里边的（房子）没有学校外边的那么安静。 (Xuéxiào lǐbian de (fángzi) méiyǒu xuéxiào wàibian de nàme ānjìng.) - The (houses) inside the school are not as quiet as those outside the school.
我每天学习一两个小时汉语。 (Wǒ měitiān xuéxí yī liǎng gè xiǎoshí Hànyǔ.) - I study Chinese for one or two hours every day.
你都喝了三四杯咖啡了，别再喝了！ (Nǐ dōu hēle sān sì bēi kāfēi le, bié zài hē le!) - You have already drunk three or four cups of coffee, don't drink any more!
从小丽家到公司骑车七八分钟就能到。 (Cóng Xiǎo Lì jiā dào gōngsī qí chē qī bā fēnzhōng jiù néng dào.) - From Xiaoli's home to the company it takes only seven or eight minutes by bike.
学校里边比学校外边方便，附近有三四个车站。 (Xuéxiào lǐbian bǐ xuéxiào wàibian fāngbiàn, fùjìn yǒu sān sì gè chēzhàn.) - Inside the school is more convenient than outside; there are three or four bus stops nearby.
数学比历史难多了。 (Shùxué bǐ lìshǐ nán duō le.) - Maths is much harder than history.
这辆自行车太旧了。 (Zhè liàng zìxíngchē tài jiù le.) - This bicycle is too old.
我还打算买辆自行车。 (Wǒ hái dǎsuàn mǎi liàng zìxíngchē.) - I also plan to buy a bicycle.
我要换一辆自行车。 (Wǒ yào huàn yí liàng zìxíngchē.) - I want to change to a different bicycle.
哪个环境更安静？ (Nǎge huánjìng gèng ānjìng?) - Which environment is quieter?
学校附近有三四个车站。 (Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu sān sì ge chēzhàn.) - There are three or four bus stops near the school.
我住在附近。 (Wǒ zhù zài fùjìn.) - I live nearby.
周末吧，来我家吃饭。 (Zhōumò ba, lái wǒ jiā chīfàn.) - The weekend; come to my home for a meal.
非常好，夏天一点儿也不热。 (Fēicháng hǎo, xiàtiān yìdiǎnr yě bú rè.) - Very good; it is not hot at all in summer.
有，一直往前走就是。 (Yǒu, yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu jiù shì.) - Yes, just keep walking straight ahead.
你怎么不太高兴？ (Nǐ zěnme bú tài gāoxìng?) - Why aren't you very happy?
你和妈妈谁起得早？ (Nǐ hé māma shéi qǐ de zǎo?) - Who gets up earlier, you or your mother?
今天我们班来了多少学生？ (Jīntiān wǒmen bān láile duōshao xuésheng?) - How many students came to our class today?
昨天呢？ (Zuótiān ne?) - What about yesterday?
你们今天玩儿了多长时间游戏了？ (Nǐmen jīntiān wánrle duō cháng shíjiān yóuxì le?) - How long did you play games today?
怎么玩儿了这么长时间？ (Zěnme wánrle zhème cháng shíjiān?) - Why did you play for such a long time?
你看这条裤子怎么样？ (Nǐ kàn zhè tiáo kùzi zěnmeyàng?) - What do you think of these trousers?
那条呢？ (Nà tiáo ne?) - What about those?
大卫和大山谁高？谁年龄大？谁的汉语说得好？ (Dàwèi hé Dàshān shéi gāo? Shéi niánlíng dà? Shéi de Hànyǔ shuō de hǎo?) - Who is taller, David or Dashan? Who is older? Whose Chinese is better?
小明为什么不喜欢数学课？ (Xiǎomíng wèi shénme bù xǐhuan shùxué kè?) - Why doesn't Xiaoming like maths class?
小明和同学打算每天一起做什么？做多长时间？ (Xiǎomíng hé tóngxué dǎsuàn měitiān yìqǐ zuò shénme? Zuò duō cháng shíjiān?) - What do Xiaoming and his classmate plan to do together every day? For how long?
小丽为什么比以前来得早了？ (Xiǎolì wèi shénme bǐ yǐqián lái de zǎo le?) - Why does Xiaoli come earlier than before?
小丽为什么要买自行车？ (Xiǎolì wèi shénme yào mǎi zìxíngchē?) - Why does Xiaoli want to buy a bicycle?
住在学校里边和学校外边有什么不一样？ (Zhù zài xuéxiào lǐbian hé xuéxiào wàibian yǒu shénme bù yíyàng?) - What is the difference between living inside the school and outside the school?
爬过两三次。 (Pá guo liǎng-sān cì.) - Have climbed two or three times.
我每天听歌听半个小时。 (Wǒ měitiān tīng gē tīng bàn ge xiǎoshí.) - I listen to songs for half an hour every day.
我听歌的时间比A长得多，我听三个小时。 (Wǒ tīng gē de shíjiān bǐ A cháng de duō, wǒ tīng sān ge xiǎoshí.) - The time I spend listening to songs is much longer than A's; I listen for three hours.
我听歌的时间没有B那么长。 (Wǒ tīng gē de shíjiān méiyǒu B nàme cháng.) - The time I spend listening to songs is not as long as B's.
我听歌的时间比B长一点儿，我听三个半小时。 (Wǒ tīng gē de shíjiān bǐ B cháng yìdiǎnr, wǒ tīng sān ge bàn xiǎoshí.) - The time I spend listening to songs is a little longer than B's; I listen for three and a half hours.
D听歌的时间最长。 (D tīng gē de shíjiān zuì cháng.) - D spends the longest time listening to songs.

通信技术进步太快了，过去跟现在不可同日而语。 (Tōngxìn jìshù jìnbù tài kuài le, guòqù gēn xiànzài bù kě tóngrì'éryǔ.) - Communication technology has progressed so fast that the past and the present cannot be mentioned in the same breath.
以前中国人结婚时，新娘穿传统的红色旗袍。 (Yǐqián Zhōngguórén jiéhūn shí, xīnniáng chuān chuántǒng de hóngsè qípáo.) - In the past, when Chinese people got married, the bride wore a traditional red cheongsam.

现在新娘既穿红色旗袍，也穿白色的婚纱，这表现了中国文化和西方文化的融合。 (Xiànzài xīnniáng jì chuān hóngsè qípáo, yě chuān báisè de hūnshā, zhè biǎoxiànle Zhōngguó wénhuà hé xīfāng wénhuà de rónghé.) - Now brides wear both red cheongsams and white wedding gowns, which reflects the blending of Chinese and Western cultures.
在你们国家，人们结婚时穿什么呢？ (Zài nǐmen guójiā, rénmen jiéhūn shí chuān shénme ne?) - In your country, what do people wear when they get married?
我先走了。 (Wǒ xiān zǒu le.) - I'll go first.
你去哪儿？ (Nǐ qù nǎr?) - Where are you going?
我去图书馆借本书。 (Wǒ qù túshūguǎn jiè běn shū.) - I'm going to the library to borrow a book.
帮我把这本词典还了吧。 (Bāng wǒ bǎ zhè běn cídiǎn huán le ba.) - Please help me return this dictionary.
好，等一会儿你离开教室的时候，记得把灯关了。 (Hǎo, děng yíhuìr nǐ líkāi jiàoshì de shíhou, jìde bǎ dēng guān le.) - OK, when you leave the classroom in a while, remember to turn off the light.
好的，放心吧。 (Hǎo de, fàng xīn ba.) - OK, don't worry.
会议结束后，别忘记把空调关了。 (Huìyì jiéshù hòu, bié wàngjì bǎ kōngtiáo guān le.) - After the meeting ends, don't forget to turn off the air conditioner.
好的。 (Hǎo de.) - OK.
王经理两点左右来了个电话。 (Wáng jīnglǐ liǎng diǎn zuǒyòu láile ge diànhuà.) - Manager Wang called at around two o'clock.
他已经到北京了？ (Tā yǐjīng dào Běijīng le?) - Has he already arrived in Beijing?
是的，他正坐地铁来我们公司呢。 (Shì de, tā zhèng zuò dìtiě lái wǒmen gōngsī ne.) - Yes, he is on his way to our company by subway.
等他到了就告诉我。 (Děng tā dào le jiù gàosu wǒ.) - Tell me as soon as he arrives.
还差一双筷子，你去拿一下。 (Hái chà yì shuāng kuàizi, nǐ qù ná yíxià.) - We are still short of a pair of chopsticks; go and get them.
今天怎么做了这么多菜？ (Jīntiān zěnme zuòle zhème duō cài?) - Why did you cook so many dishes today?
今天是你爸爸的生日。 (Jīntiān shì nǐ bàba de shēngrì.) - Today is your dad's birthday.
真的啊？ (Zhēn de a?) - Really?
我把爸爸的生日忘了。 (Wǒ bǎ bàba de shēngrì wàng le.) - I forgot Dad's birthday.
那我们今天喝点儿啤酒吧。 (Nà wǒmen jīntiān hē diǎnr píjiǔ ba.) - Then let's drink some beer today.

医生说你爸爸一口酒都不能喝，别让他看见酒瓶子。 (Yīshēng shuō nǐ bàba yì kǒu jiǔ dōu bù néng hē, bié ràng tā kànjiàn jiǔ píngzi.) - The doctor says your dad can't drink even a mouthful of alcohol; don't let him see the bottles.
